historical_record.description: Built to the design of Paul J. Capurro, whose North Beach work the city's survey documents.
Recorded in the city's 1982 survey of North Beach, adopted by the Board of Supervisors in 1999, as an individually listed resource.
The city's survey records surviving sidewalk lights — prism glass set into the pavement to light basements — in front of this address.
Identified by the 2019 updated North Beach survey as appearing eligible for local landmark or California Register / National Register status — recorded as Molinari Delicatessen and the Liguria Hotel.

building.completed_conflict: This building's context statement dates the work 1912; the assessor's roll records the parcel as built 1910.
